contract.description: The version of this format the widget is written against. Always 1.

name.description: The widget type's name: lowercase, digits and dashes. Must equal the name in the URL it is written to.

title.description: The tab's or button's label. {param} placeholders are filled from the instance's params, e.g. "{key}". Defaults to the name.

description.description: One line saying what the widget shows, for the + menu.

icon.description: An icon name from the guide's list (ticket, clock, list-checks, git-pull-request, activity, …). Unknown names fall back to a generic icon.

params.description: The values an instance is opened with, by name. Each is substituted into the title, the Claude prompt, and handed to the Node script.

placements.description: Where an instance may be drawn; the first is the default. tab: a tab in the session's tab strip, the view filling the pane. tab-popover: a compact button in the tab strip that opens the view in a popover. header: a chip in the session's main header that opens the view in a popover.

badge.description: A dot path into the data ("count", "today.total") whose value is shown as short text after the icon of a tab-popover or header instance.

popover.description: The popover's size, for the two popover placements. The view can also ask with hangar.resize(height).

secrets.description: Names of secrets a node source needs (JIRA_API_TOKEN). The user enters each one in Hangar once; the script gets them on stdin. Never put a secret's value in any file.

prompt.description: The description the widget was written from, kept so it can be regenerated or amended. Update it when the widget changes.

pattern.description: A regex. A value given, or read from the session, is cut down to its first match: "PROJ-123 login timeout" with [A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-\d+ becomes "PROJ-123".

default.description: Used when no value is given and none is found in the session.

required.description: Defaults to true unless the param has a default.

from.description: Where to look in the session when no value is given, in order: its name, its git branch, its folder. A param filled this way stays linked: it is read again on every fetch.

kind.description: node: run a Node script (fetch.mjs by default) that prints the data as JSON. claude: run a headless Claude prompt with an MCP tool allowlist and a JSON schema for the answer.

run.description: node: the script, relative to the widget's folder. Defaults to fetch.mjs.

prompt.description: claude: the prompt. {param}, {session}, {branch}, {folder} and {today} are filled in.

tools.description: claude: the MCP tools the run may call, by full name (mcp__claude_ai_Jira__getJiraIssue). No built-in tool is available.

model.description: claude: the model id or alias (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, sonnet). Defaults to claude-haiku-4-5-20251001.

schema.description: claude: the JSON Schema the answer must match; it arrives as the data. Keep it flat and small.

refresh.description: "manual", or an interval such as "30s", "5m", "1h". At least 30s for node, 15m for claude. Refreshes run only while the instance is on screen.
